description: Listing automations with limit=1 over a two-row collection returns page 1 with a non-null opaque cursor; page 2 is requested with the cursor RETURNED by page 1, passed back verbatim exactly as API-033 requires (never a client-constructed literal), and returns the remaining row with cursor:null — the two pages together enumerate every row exactly once, in stable creation order. The token's internal form is deliberately not asserted here: API-033 makes a cursor opaque to the client, and API-036 is the only spelling rule (a charset grammar) a conformant implementation owes.
